2026-10-15 review fail by reviewer: FAIL. Blocking: (1) packages/ui-web/src/components/navigation/segmented-control.tsx:38-43: segments lost their 44px touch hit area. The old label grew from 32px to 44px with before:-inset-y-1.5. Now a label is 32px (md) or 28px (sm) with no pseudo element, and a tap 4px above it lands on the fieldset (measured with the built CSS under pointer: coarse). This breaks DESIGN.md:281 on the Transactions direction filter, both overview range controls and the invoice form. (2) segmented-control.tsx:31: auto-cols-fr compiles to minmax(0,1fr), so a track too narrow for its options squeezes segments below their labels instead of scrolling as DESIGN.md:60, the comment at :17-19 and the /kit demo (components-showcase.tsx:204-224) say. Rendered with the built CSS and Geist, the kit demo reads "SettledExpiredCance"; at 320px the invoice form's expiry row shows "30 days" touching a faded "Custom". A max-content minimum (e.g. auto-cols-[minmax(max-content,1fr)]) scrolls with no overlap in the same render. (3) apps/web/src/screens/app-shell/app-header.tsx:28-29,81: the phone search trigger went from 36px with after:-inset-y-1 (44px hit area) to 40px with no extension, which breaks the same 44px rule. (4) apps/web/src/features/invoices/components/invoice-actions.tsx:123-126: the item shows "Open pay page" but its accessible name "Open the pay page in a new tab" does not contain the visible text (WCAG 2.5.3 Label in Name, level A). Start the name with the visible text and update the e2e names. (5) Docs and dead code: DESIGN.md:74 and switch.tsx:13 say the thumb is the lightest part of the switch on and off in both themes, but the light-mode off thumb is bg-subtle #566a62 on bg-surface-2 #eaf2f0 (switch.tsx:36). In docs/PROJECT.md:130-131, R-85 follows a blank line, so it renders outside the requirements table. This change removed the last two uses of SwapLabel (ui-web buttons/swap-label.tsx, index.ts:14-15, docs/web/structure.md:141), so remove it. Non-blocking: button.tsx:38,47 gives the link variant rounded-sm on top of BASE rounded-pill, which works only because Tailwind emits rounded-sm later; code-input.tsx:59-60 has the same pattern (border-field plus border-field-focus). search-field.tsx:45: Clear removes itself, so keyboard focus drops to body; focus the input after clearing. invoice-detail.tsx:223-227: cancelable no longer needs payable, so for up to one poll after local expiry the menu offers only Cancel, which the API refuses with 409. invoices-table.tsx:100: a phone with no invoices shows New invoice twice. calendar.tsx:109: a disabled month arrow still tints on hover. networks.tsx:37: the marquee loops forever and pauses only under a mouse, so touch and keyboard users cannot pause it (WCAG 2.2.2); reduced motion stops it. base.css:10,111: scroll-padding plus scroll-margin add up to 12rem. Stale comments: pay-copy.ts:38 (removed copyShort/copiedShort) and sign-in-screen.tsx:52 (the form is now items-start). app-shell.tsx:175: "Skip to content" is not in SHELL_COPY. structure.md does not list select-menu. pay.spec.ts:696-700 repeats sidewaysScroll inline. tokens.css:28: --fw-field (about 1.5:1 on bg) is not in contrast.test.ts. hero-payment.tsx:48: the hash is no longer mono. Fine: the test changes keep their intent. sideways.ts compares scrollWidth with the root width, which equals the old ===390 check with no gutter and is stricter than the old innerWidth check in pay.spec. axe.ts skips only scroll-timeline animations (fw-scroll-fade, whose finished never resolves) and still waits for every time-based fade. The pay centering check uses the root width. The menu steps still check the copied link, clipboard, href and filtered counts. The settled helper reads the hover color after its transition. No Go, SQL or API changes; layout.html.tmpl uses token colors. Money, auth and API code is untouched. InvoiceActions calls every hook before its early return. invoices->activity (StatusFilter) is a listed edge, and ListToolbar has 3 consumers. pnpm lint and the ui-web (14) and design-tokens (52) tests pass.
